structs.notes: Proposal, not applied (size change and child retype are coordinator decisions). Replay ShakePerlinScale is 32 bytes, not 40: ApplyBlendSample@0x141678F30 writes only +0..+28 (+0/+4/+8 scale defaults 1.0 and the m_initialized flag at +12 (set to 1 or 0), +16/+20/+24 instant scales from FloatCurveSampleLinear lerps, +28 m_value), and the two targets bs+36 and bs+68 are 32 apart, so a 40-byte ShakePerlinScale would alias the next one. Game-test fields m_valueInstant (+32) and m_outValueSmoothed (+36) have no Replay write and do not exist in the 32-byte layout. That is a CHILD-STRUCT PROPOSAL for ShakePerlinScale (not in this agent's entry): size 40 -> 32, delete the trailing m_valueInstant and m_outValueSmoothed unless another Replay function proves them, and the _padD (13..15) pad stays as the game-test shape. Evidence: CG_ViewMotion_ApplyBlendSample@0x141678F30 and CG_ViewMotion_UpdateBlendState@0x1416794C0.
